verdict.rationale: Fellow has an AI assistant ('Ask Fellow'), so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it can act as an MCP client. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Fellow as an MCP server that external assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Fellow itself connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
